BiblicalUsage: Baal = "lord"; n pr m; 1) supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites; 2) a Reubenite; 3) the son of Jehiel and grandfather of Saul; n pr loc; 4) a town of Simeon, probably identical to Baalath-beer
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
